title: Success story
question: 把今天课文里的“一个小技能 -> 多年练习和成长 -> 后来又回到最早的小请求”的线索，换成一个现代生活场景——这一题不打分，老师只会鼓励 + 给一句小建议。把下面 3 个空补完整，用 word bank 里的词或短语。
example_answer: When she was young, she used to edit short videos. She practised after school and saved money for better equipment. In a few years, her small channel had become a student media team. But one day, her cousin asked her to edit a birthday video again.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 过去习惯：小时候经常做的简单技能
options.english_template: When she was young, she ___ edit short videos.

options.label: B
options.scenario_zh: 成长过程：几年后，小频道变成更大的团队
options.english_template: In a few years, her small channel ___ a student media team.

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 温暖回环：家人又请她做最早那件小事
options.english_template: But one day, her ___ to edit a birthday video again.
